name: NTR'ed by My Dad
source:
Eric brings his gentle wife, Grace, to his father Fletcher’s countryside estate for a short stay. What begins as a simple, peaceful getaway slowly unravels in the stillness of this quiet town.

Fletcher, a cheerful and well-built middle-aged fitness coach, carries the allure only a seasoned man can offer. He treats his son with kindness, always warm on the surface—but deep down, he represses intense desires, particularly an unhealthy obsession with things that are “beautiful yet claimed by others”… like someone else’s wife.

Neighbors Hailey and her husband Ian only add fuel to the fire, turning this into a spiraling game of desire. You will decide how the story unfolds—
Will it spiral quickly into corruption, or burn slowly from within?
Will it be a show for voyeurs, or a descent from restraint into total loss of control?​

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/user/about?u=78902436]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
埃里克带着他温柔的妻子格蕾丝来到他父亲弗莱彻的乡村庄园短暂停留。原本简单、宁静的度假之旅在这座安静小镇的宁静中慢慢展开。

弗莱彻是一位性格开朗、体格健壮的中年健身教练，拥有只有经验丰富的男人才能提供的魅力。他对待儿子很友善，表面上总是很热情，但内心深处却压抑着强烈的欲望，尤其是对“美丽却被别人占有”的事物的不健康的痴迷……比如别人的妻子。

邻居海莉和她的丈夫伊恩只是火上浇油，把这变成了一场不断升级的欲望游戏。你将决定故事如何展开——
它会迅速陷入腐败，还是从内部慢慢燃烧？
这会是一场偷窥者的表演，还是从克制下降到完全失控？​
